svg.title: Compare before removing
svg.desc: Preserve both files first. Compare their origins, version labels and audio at matching passages. Separate file identity from recording identity, and keep an unresolved pair rather than making a deletion decision from a title, duration or tag alone.

text.font-family: Pretendard, SUIT, Noto Sans KR, Apple SD Gothic Neo, Inter, system-ui, sans-serif
